Fatfish's Free Lunch - a free, open-source, non-commercial fan game. Not affiliated with DeepSeek.
Assets: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Code: MIT.

Characters
Original character Mingyue: 上善无形 (Bilibili) - CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
Maid version Blue Fatfish: ZipZipPipe (Bilibili) - CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

Fatfish art and animation: high-resolution redraws based on these characters, AI-assisted and retouched by hand, animated in-game with real-time mesh deformation.

Fonts: Noto Sans SC, ZCOOL KuaiLe - SIL Open Font License
Engine: Godot Engine - MIT
部分美术（场景、梁阿姨、食物、饭盒）、音效和音乐由 AI 辅助生成（gpt-im: Some of the art (the canteen, Auntie Liang, the food, the lunch boxes), the sound effects and the music were made with AI tools (gpt-image, ElevenLabs), then picked, edited and assembled by hand.
深度思考、上下文 64K（流式、连击和招牌菜的成长上限提高）、饭点延长: Deep Thinking, 64K context (higher Streaming, combo and signature-dish growth caps), and a longer meal
混合思考（好菜自动标出落点）、上下文 128K（成长上限提高）、饭点延长: Hybrid Thinking (landing guides for good food), 128K context (higher growth caps), and a longer meal
V3.1-Terminus 终于不再冒「极」字了: V3.1-Terminus finally stops spouting the Ji glitch
DSA 稀疏注意力（未学顿悟时避开青菜）、上下文 256K（成长上限提高）、饭点: DSA Sparse Attention (avoid greens unless Grokking is learned), 256K context (higher growth caps), and a longer meal
上下文 1M（流式、连击和招牌菜的成长上限提高）、饭点延长: 1M context (higher Streaming, combo and signature-dish growth caps), and a longer meal
通关！大肥鱼实现了 AGI，然后又饿了: You did it! Fatfish achieved AGI. Now she's hungry again.
先学会「今日菜单」，再挑想划掉的菜。: Learn Today’s Menu before choosing dishes to cross out.
这道菜还没有开放。: This dish is not available yet.
每个档口至少保留一道菜。: Keep at least one dish at every stall.
端着饭盒碰一下左边的保温箱，留到最后吃: Touch the warmer on the left with a loaded box. Save it for last.
按住空格或右键，时间变慢: Hold Space / RMB to slow time
让她把青菜硬咽下去，咽够就开窍: Keep swallowing greens until it finally clicks
「极」掉进饭盒了！甩掉它！: A 「极」 fell in the box! Shake it out!
青菜从现在起很值钱: Greens are now worth a lot
评测没过：差 %s token（门票已花掉，随时可以再来）: Review failed: %s tokens short (the ticket is spent; try again any time)
每条进度是一把勺子 · 满格后抛菜: One bar per ladle · Full bar means a serving
放进来，留到最后: Put it here. Save it for last.
服务器繁忙，请稍后重试: Server busy, please try again later
没空饭盒了！等她吃完……: No empty boxes! Wait for her to finish...
蓝线：饭盒高度的预计落点: Blue mark: landing at box height
开饭前划掉不想要的菜，想要的出得更多。: Cross off unwanted dishes before lunch. Get more of the ones you like.
选一道招牌菜，这顿它有特别加成。: Choose a signature dish for a special bonus this meal.
再点一次「回滚」：所有技能全额退款，重新加点: Click Rollback again: every skill is refunded in full
已提交：点右下角红色按钮开始评测: Submitted: press the red button at the bottom right to start the review
右键退掉这个技能（全额退款）: Right-click to refund this skill in full
要先在这一环升满 %d 级（现在 %d 级）: Needs %d levels in this ring first (now %d)
请先不要退出游戏，检查磁盘空间和存档文件夹的写入权限。: Keep the game open. Check free disk space and save-folder permissions.
记录这份存档里，你和大肥鱼的小小里程碑。: The little milestones you and Fatfish have reached in this save.
本地成就 · 方向键 / 摇杆浏览 · Esc / B 返回: Local achievements · Arrows / Stick to browse · Esc / B to go back
J / 空格 下一页 Esc 跳过: J / Space next page    Esc skip
一张留给你的饭票: A meal ticket, just for you
按自己的节奏翻页 · Esc / B 返回技能树: Take your time · Esc / B to return to upgrades
从第一盒热饭，到最后一场评测。\n你接住的每一口，都成了她长大的养分。:
From the first warm lunchbox to the final test.
Every bite you caught helped her grow.
这张饭票，记着你们一起走过的路。: This ticket remembers the journey you shared.
「了不起的事明天再说，\n今天还吃不吃？」:
"Save the big ideas for tomorrow.
Are you eating or not?"
大肥鱼没说话。\n她把空饭盆，又往前推了推。:
Fatfish said nothing.
She just pushed her empty bowl a little closer.
食堂还会开门。\n还没点亮的技能、没尝过的套餐，都在等你。\n下次开饭，也请多关:
The canteen will open again.
More upgrades and untasted combos are waiting.
See you at the next meal.
送给每一个认真接住生活里那一口热饭的人。: For everyone who makes room for a warm meal.

把不想吃的划掉，让喜欢的菜多出一点。: Cross off a dish to make more room for your favourites.
把喜欢的菜选为招牌，让这一顿吃出自己的风格。: Pick signature dishes and give this meal your own flavour.
还没有划掉任何菜，今天全都保留。: Nothing crossed off. Everything stays on today's menu.
先升级档口，就能把喜欢的菜挂上招牌。: Upgrade your stalls to make more dishes available.
即时保存 · Enter / A 选择 · Esc / B 返回: Saved as you choose · Enter / A to select · Esc / B to go back
每档至少留一道；名额用满时，新选择会替换最早划掉的一项。: Keep one dish per stall. At capacity, new choices replace the oldest cross-off.
空位会自动补齐；选择别的菜，就能换掉最早的一道招牌。: Empty slots fill automatically. A new dish replaces the oldest signature.
这道菜不出餐，原本的机会留给同档口的其他菜。: This dish won't be served. Other dishes from its stall take its place.
这道菜照常出餐。点击卡片，可以把它从今日菜单划掉。: This dish is on the menu. Select its card to cross it off.
升级「今日菜单」增加划菜名额。: Upgrade Today's Menu to cross off more dishes.
升级「MoE 激活专家」增加招牌名额。: Upgrade MoE: Activate Experts for more signature slots.
招牌会自动补齐，选择另一道菜即可替换。: Signature slots fill automatically. Pick another dish to replace this one.
每吃一份，本顿它的价值 +%d%%（叠加）: Each one eaten: +%d%% value for it this meal (stacks)
价值 ×%.1f，但它的档口出餐慢 %d%%: Value ×%.1f, but its stall cooks %d%% slower
窗口失去焦点，已为你暂停。\n点击继续上班，饭菜不会凉。:
The game lost focus, so your shift is paused.
Choose Resume when you're ready.
移动鼠标直接控制饭盒；键盘 WASD / 方向键、手柄左摇杆也能移动。到右侧饭桌: Move the mouse to steer your box, or use WASD / arrows / the left stick. At the table on the right, click / press E / A to pick up a box. Catch food and bring it back. Food earns tokens when she eats it.
每条进度对应一只独立备菜的勺子。档口显示出菜数量；多条代表同时备菜，并非食物品质: Each bar is one ladle preparing food independently. More bars mean more ladles working at once. A full bar launches food along its own path. Stall upgrades unlock more dishes.
同一饭盒凑齐菜谱原料会自动合成套餐，原料的品质收益会计入套餐价值。合成后的占格按: Matching ingredients in one box automatically form a combo. Ingredient quality contributes to its value. Each recipe has its own space cost; Context Compression saves one extra cell, down to one. Discovered recipes enter your collection.
银色为优质，散菜价值 ×2；金色为金牌，×4，FP32 解锁后 ×5。入盒后仍保: Silver dishes are worth ×2; gold dishes ×4, or ×5 with FP32. Their glow stays visible inside a box. A gold box boosts the whole meal's income. The Divergent Thinking skill attracts nearby food while thinking.
解锁后按住空格 / 右键 / B，让食物放慢，饭盒保持正常移动。结束后冷却 1: Once unlocked, hold Space / right-click / B to slow food while your box moves normally. After stopping, wait 1 second, release the button and recover at least 0.5 seconds of energy before pressing again. Markers predict where food crosses your box's height.
已吃下的主食、荤菜、素菜越接近 4∶3∶3，均衡倍率越高。青菜单吃原本会被吐掉，: Balance improves as eaten starch, meat and vegetables approach 4:3:3. She initially spits out plain greens; use combos, Prompt Injection or Grokking to handle them. Your receipt shows the income multipliers, with no hidden deductions.
解锁 Prompt 模板后，至少两份同一种散菜装满盒，也算单品拼盘，可触发多轮对: With Prompt Template, fill a box with at least two portions of one plain dish to make a platter and keep a combo chain. Context Memory rewards changing dishes between consecutive platters. Ghost food does not count; platters are not new recipes.
08 · 留点空间，下盒加餐: 08 · Leave room, boost the next box
上下文压缩解锁后，亲手送出含套餐且空至少两格的盒子，可存一份缓存。下一只亲手送出: With Context Compression, serve a box containing a combo and at least two empty cells to store a cache. Your next full box spends it for +15% income. Only one cache can be held. Helpers cannot store or spend it.
今日菜单划掉的菜不会再出，每个档口至少留一道。招牌菜的特别效果会作用于本顿饭；满: Today's Menu removes crossed-out dishes, leaving at least one per stall. Signature dishes add special effects for the next meal. When slots are full, a new pick replaces the oldest. Both settings share one panel.
Esc / P / Start 暂停；切到其他窗口默认自动暂停。回来后点击继续上: Esc / P / Start pauses your shift. Switching to another window pauses by default. Choose Resume when you return. Closing Settings or the recipe book leaves the game paused.
单吃 0（她挑食，会吐掉）: 0 on its own (she spits it out)
开饭啦！计时开始: Lunch is on! The clock has started
继续接菜、送桌；关门后用 token 升级。: Keep catching and serving. Spend your tokens on upgrades after closing.
随时按 Esc / Start 暂停。: Press Esc / Start to pause at any time.
把饭盒送上桌: Bring the box to the table
方向键 / WASD 移到右下角餐桌，按 E / Enter 拿盒。: Move to the bottom-right table with WASD / arrow keys. Press E / Enter to take a box.
方向键 / WASD 移动饭盒，接住一份落下的菜。: Move the box with WASD / arrow keys and catch a falling dish.
把饭盒移回右下角餐桌，按 E / Enter 送给她。: Bring the box to the bottom-right table. Press E / Enter to serve.
左摇杆移到右下角餐桌，按 A 拿盒。: Move to the bottom-right table with the left stick. Press A to take a box.
左摇杆移动饭盒，接住一份落下的菜。: Move the box with the left stick and catch a falling dish.
把饭盒移回右下角餐桌，按 A 送给她。: Bring the box to the bottom-right table. Press A to serve.
把鼠标移到右下角餐桌，点击拿盒。: Move the mouse to the bottom-right table and click to take a box.
移动鼠标，把饭盒放在落下的菜下面。: Move the mouse to place your box under a falling dish.
把饭盒移回右下角餐桌，点击送给她。: Bring the box to the bottom-right table and click to serve.
先完成一次送餐，再开始计时。不用装满也能送。: The clock starts after your first delivery. The box does not need to be full.
方向键选择 · Enter / A 确认 · Esc / B 返回: Arrows to navigate · Enter / A to select · Esc / B to return
音量即时生效，音乐、音效和配音可以分别调整。: Adjust music, effects and voices separately. Changes apply immediately.
窗口会居中并自动适应可用屏幕；全屏时保留所选窗口尺寸。: The window centers and fits your screen. Fullscreen keeps your chosen window size for later.
设置会自动保存，下次开饭继续沿用。: Settings save automatically for your next meal.
减少装饰动画和漂浮粒子，保留接菜所需的运动提示。: Reduce decorative animation and floating particles while keeping essential catching cues.
合成或重要接菜时短暂停顿，关闭后保持连续动作。: A brief pause gives combinations and special catches extra weight. Turn off for continuous motion.
切到后台时暂停上班: Pause the shift when in the background
清除后将失去全部饭票、升级和成就。此操作无法撤销。: This removes all meal tickets, upgrades and achievements. It cannot be undone.
接住梁阿姨抛来的饭，喂饱大肥鱼: Catch what Auntie Liang flings. Feed the Fatfish.
角色「蓝色大肥鱼」：原型「溟月」© 上善无形，女仆版 © ZipZipPipe，: Character "Blue Fatfish": original "Mingyue" © 上善无形, maid version © ZipZipPipe, adapted under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. A free fan game, not affiliated with DeepSeek.
目标是实现AGI！但是也要先吃饱。: The goal is AGI! But first, a proper meal.
主食窗口（柜台正中间）升级，菜单多一道菜：饭团和白粥 → 炒饭 → 金饭团。: Upgrade the central staple stall to expand its menu: onigiri and congee → fried rice → golden onigiri.
开张炒菜窗口：番茄炒蛋和青菜。再升级会出土豆丝、红烧肉，最后是宫保鸡丁。小心：她: Open the stir-fry stall: tomato & egg and bok choy. Upgrades add potato strips, braised pork, then kung pao chicken. She dislikes plain greens!
开张面点窗口：包子和油条。再升级会出豆浆、饺子，最后是小笼包。: Open the dim sum stall: meat buns and youtiao. Upgrades add soy milk and dumplings, then soup dumplings.
开张炸物窗口：鸡腿和薯条。再升级会出冰可乐，最后是炸鸡汉堡。: Open the fried-food stall: drumsticks and fries. Upgrades add iced cola, then chicken burgers.
开张甜品窗口：布丁和奶茶。再升级会出双皮奶，最后是冰激凌。: Open the dessert stall: pudding and milk tea. Upgrades add milk custard, then ice cream.
解锁「今日菜单」按钮：开饭前划掉不想要的菜，它就不会再出，同窗口的其他菜出得更多: Unlock Today’s Menu: cross out dishes before a meal so their stall serves the other choices more often. Each level lets you remove one more dish. Every open stall must keep at least one dish.
抛下来的菜有几率是「优质菜」：带银色扫光，价值 ×2。每级几率 +8%。: Thrown dishes can be Premium, with a silver sheen and twice the value. Each level adds an 8% chance.
今日菜单里每划掉 1 道菜，剩下的菜是优质菜的几率 +3%。: Each crossed-off dish in Today's Menu adds 3% to the remaining dishes' chance of being Premium.
优质菜有几率直接升成「金牌菜」：带金色辉光，价值 ×4。每级几率 +20%。: Premium dishes can become Gold, with a golden glow and four times the value. Each level adds a 20% chance.
金牌菜的价值从 ×4 提到 ×5。: Gold dishes rise from ×4 to ×5 value.
解锁「招牌菜」按钮：开饭前选一道招牌菜，这一顿它有特别加成（比如越吃越值钱）。每: Unlock Signature Dishes. Pick dishes before lunch for special bonuses, such as rising value with each bite. Choose 1 more per level.
每个窗口抛菜时，有几率顺手多给一勺青菜（每级 +15%）。青菜能凑套餐、补素菜，: Each serving may include extra greens (+15% chance per level). Use them in combos, balance the meal, or train Grokking.
梁阿姨多长一条触手：多一把勺子在抛菜，菜更多。: Auntie Liang grows another tentacle: one more ladle, more food in the air.
每一口有几率暴击：这口 ×2，她会先托腮想一下再狠狠咬下去。每级暴击几率 +3%: Each bite can crit for ×2 value. She pauses to think, then takes a huge bite. Each level adds 3% crit chance and 0.1 to the multiplier.
每一勺有几率多抛一样菜，每级几率 +25%。: Each ladleful may throw an extra dish. Chance +25% per level.
饭点里隔一会儿来一阵「高峰」：出菜 ×2.5，稀有菜更常见。每级高峰多 3 秒。: Rush hours come in waves: ×2.5 serving speed and more rare dishes. Each level extends the rush by 3 seconds.
菜掉进饭盒时，有几率变成同窗口、同类的高一级菜（比如青菜 → 土豆丝）；已经最高: When a dish lands in your box, it may become the next dish from the same stall and food category. A top-tier dish gains a quality grade instead. Changed dishes glow with a little flame and are worth ×1.5. Ingredients needed for your closest recipe are protected. Each level adds an 8% chance.
带小火苗的菜（被变过的、幻觉出来的、暴击的那口）每级再值钱 +0.25 倍。: Flame-marked food (transformed, hallucinated, or a critical bite) gains +0.25 to its value multiplier per level.
菜掉进饭盒时，有几率凭空多出一口同窗口的菜，不占格子（饭盒角上显示 +1）。每级: Catching food may create an extra bite from the same stall. It uses no space (shown as +1 on the box). Chance +8% per level.
送上桌的饭盒有几率整盒「重抽」：盒里每样散菜都换成更高级的菜。每级几率 +10%: A delivered box may reroll all its plain dishes into better dishes. Chance +10% per level.
一盒里凑够 3 样带小火苗的菜时，有 25% 几率合成「涌现乱炖」：神级套餐，非: Collect 3 flame-marked dishes in a box for a 25% chance to make Emergent Stew: a valuable Legendary combo.
（要先「顿悟」）掉进饭盒的散菜有 15% 几率变成青菜。开窍后的她最爱青菜。: Requires Grokking. Caught plain dishes have a 15% chance to become greens. Once she gets it, she loves them.
饭盒变宽一列（2×2 → 2×3 → 2×4），接菜范围也变宽；每级还多给你一个: Widen the box by one column (2×2 → 2×3 → 2×4), catching a wider area. Each level also gives you another box.
每一盒饭的收入 +20%（每级）。: Each box earns 20% more per level.
小炒套餐每级 +0.2 倍。亲手送出装满同一道散菜的饭盒（至少两份），就是「单品: Each level adds 0.2 to simple-set multipliers. Personally serve a full box of one loose dish, with at least two servings, to make a Single-Dish Platter: +10% box income per level, and it qualifies for combos. Mixed grades are fine; ghosts do not count. Platters do not unlock cookbook recipes.
换更好的饭盒：铁 → 铜 → 银 → 金，整顿收入 ×1.5 / ×2 / ×3: Upgrade your box: Iron → Copper → Silver → Gold, for ×1.5 / ×2 / ×3 meal income. Material boosts income. To pull food closer, use Divergent Thinking during Deep Thinking.
送出的饭盒一格都没空着，这盒收入 +25%。: Deliver a box with no empty cells to earn 25% more from it.
「二级套餐」（3 样菜合成）更值钱，每级 +0.3 倍。乱炖也算二级套餐。: Tier 2 Combos (3 ingredients) gain +0.3 to their value multiplier per level. Mixed Stew also counts as Tier 2.
合成套餐时，盒里的一棵青菜会被偷偷藏进套餐：不占格子，她吃不出来，还算吃了一份素: Making a combo hides one green from the box inside it. It takes no extra space, she won't notice, and it still counts as vegetables.
套餐少占 1 格（最少 1 格）。亲手送出含套餐且空着至少两格的饭盒，存一份「余: Sets take one fewer cell, with a minimum of one. Personally serve a box containing a set and at least two empty cells to store a Spare-Space Cache. Your next personally served full box earns +15%. It holds one charge; use it, then prepare another.
「三级大餐」（4–5 样菜合成）更值钱，每级 +0.4 倍。: Tier 3 Feasts (4-5 ingredients) gain +0.4 to their value multiplier per level.
饭盒里有 3 份菜名、品级和火苗状态都相同的散菜时，合成 1 份更高品级的（普通: Three loose servings of the same dish, grade and flame status merge into one higher-grade serving: Regular → Premium → Gold. The result keeps that dish’s normal cell size, freeing the other two servings’ space.
饭盒装满，又没有只差一样的套餐时，3 样来自不同窗口的散菜自动压成一份「乱炖」（: When your box is full and no recipe is just one ingredient away, three loose dishes from different stalls combine into a tier-two Mixed Stew, freeing space.
套餐还能当原料，合成更大的套餐。一盒里每这样连着合成一次，这盒收入 +30%（最: Combos can be ingredients for bigger combos. Each such chain merge adds 30% to that box's earnings, up to 3 times.
套餐里每用到一样优质或金牌原料，这份套餐每级再值钱 +2（还会乘套餐倍率）。: Each Premium or Gold ingredient in a combo adds 2 value per level, before the combo multiplier.
「神级套餐」（6 样以上，或隐藏配方）更值钱，每级 +0.6 倍。: Legendary combos (6+ ingredients or hidden recipes) gain +0.6 to their value multiplier per level.
